name: Jinko Solar Bifacial Monocrystalline PV Module, 615W
short_description: 615W bifacial monocrystalline module that also harvests light reflected onto its rear face.
long_description:
The Tiger Neo 615W is a bifacial monocrystalline module: it generates from the front face like any panel, and adds output from light reflected onto its rear face â€” a real advantage over bright iron-sheet roofs and light-coloured ground. At 615W per module, an array reaches a target size with fewer panels, less rail and less labour than lower-wattage alternatives.

Jinko Solar is a Tier 1 manufacturer and one of the largest module makers in the world. This module suits residential arrays with limited roof area and commercial installations where cost per installed watt matters. Pair it with the mounting rails, clamps and MC4 connectors listed under this product.

name: Hexing All-in-One Solar Street Light 60W (N)
short_description: 60W all-in-one solar street light with integrated panel, battery and N LED head.
long_description:
An all-in-one solar street light: panel, LiFePO4 battery, controller and a 60W LED head in a single sealed unit. There is no trenching, no cabling and no mains connection â€” it mounts on a pole and runs itself, charging by day and lighting from dusk.

The 60W head suits estate roads, gate areas, parking and security lighting around homes, farms and business premises. Supplied by Hexing, the manufacturer behind the Livoltek range, with a 2-year warranty.
